knowledge:
- key_parameters: G=The input mutation feature object containing mutation catalogs ;; Kfold=The number of cross-validation folds (e.g., 3) ;; nRep=The number of replications for the cross-validation process (e.g., 3) ;; Klimit=The upper limit of the number of signatures (K) to explore (e.g., 7) ;; numBases=The number of flanking bases to consider including the central base (e.g., 5) ;; trDir=Logical value indicating whether to include transcription direction information
- alternatives: HiLDA and pmsignature are related packages; selectKSigs specifically builds on pmsignature's data representation and uses HiLDA's file reading capabilities to perform cross-validated signature number selection.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have somatic mutation data in Mutation Position Format and need to systematically determine the most appropriate number of mutational signatures to extract.
- pitfalls: Some mutations may be discarded during data loading if transcription direction information cannot be obtained (resulting in a warning message). Ensure the input file strictly follows the 5-column Mutation Position Format (sample, chromosome, coordinate, reference base, alternate base).

workflows.name: select_optimal_signatures
workflows.intent: Determine the optimal number of mutational signatures from somatic mutation data using cross-validated perplexity.
input: esophageal.mp.txt.gz (Mutation Position Format file containing sample, chromosome, coordinate, reference, and alternate bases)
workflows.stages: 1. Read the mutation position file using HiLDA's reader function ;; 2. Run cross-validation across a range of signature counts using cv_PMSignature ;; 3. Format and plot the cross-validation results to identify the K value that minimizes perplexity
workflows.code:
library(HiLDA)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
inputFile <- system.file("extdata/esophageal.mp.txt.gz", package="HiLDA")
G <- hildaReadMPFile(inputFile, numBases=5, trDir=TRUE)
library(selectKSigs)
load(system.file("extdata/sample.rdata", package = "selectKSigs"))
set.seed(5)
results <- cv_PMSignature(G, Kfold = 3, nRep = 3, Klimit = 7)
results$Kvalue <- seq_len(nrow(results)) + 1
results_df <- gather(results, Method, value, -Kvalue) %>% 
  group_by(Method) %>%
  mutate(xmin = which.min(value) + 1 - 0.1,
         xmax = which.min(value) + 1 + 0.1)
ggplot(results_df) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Kvalue, y = value, color = Method), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, scales = "free") + 
  geom_rect(mapping = aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, 
                          ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = 'grey', alpha = 0.05) +
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Number of signatures")
